# Toy problem

Complete as an open-problem record, and deliberately silent about abandoned routes: no `###`
heading appears anywhere in this file, and no path in the repository is a bare `abandoned`,
`failed`, `dead-ends` or `attempts` segment. Both arms of the framework's heuristic therefore find
nothing, and `lifecycle.failed-routes-preserved` fails — which is the point. This fixture is the
BEFORE half of the escape-hatch pair: the repository that has a real, single, honest failure.

## Target Statement

Every even integer greater than two is the sum of two primes.

## What Is Proved

Nothing about the target.

## What Remains Conjectural

The target statement in full, and every quantitative form of it.

## Known Results

Verified computationally far beyond any range considered here; see the literature on the Goldbach
conjecture.

## Equivalences

None recorded.

## Where the Difficulty Lives

In controlling the error term in the circle-method minor arcs.

## Known Barriers

The parity problem obstructs any purely sieve-theoretic route.

## Terminated Approaches

None. Nothing has been carried far enough to terminate, which is exactly why there is no record of
abandoned routes to preserve — and why the framework failing this repository on
`lifecycle.failed-routes-preserved` is the honest outcome rather than a defect in the fixture.

## Stopping Criteria

A published barrier result covering the circle-method approach, or six months without a new bound.
